source_video: Why You Procrastinate — It’s Not Just Laziness

shorts.title: Procrastination Is a Mood Decision
shorts.description:
You call yourself lazy, but procrastination is often a mood decision disguised as a time decision. The relief you feel when you avoid a task is the clue.

Watch the full explanation on The Inner Machine.

shorts.title: Make Procrastination Easier to Beat
shorts.description:
Do not wait for motivation. Make the next action smaller than the emotion attached to it. Open the document, write one ugly sentence, and give yourself ten minutes.

Watch the full explanation on The Inner Machine.
